Question 1
?

Given that u=1+x2, which integral is equivalent to ∫x3dx1+x2?

a
12∫u−1/2du
b
12∫(u1/2−u−1/2)du
c
2∫(u1/2−u−1/2)du
d
2∫u1/2du
e
12∫(u1/2+u−1/2)du
